~~The issue is actually different in master in that the state is maintained when a new scene is created (and this works), but it should be reset.~~

**Edit:**  The above section is to be determined per: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/117721#issuecomment-4106568364

**Edit:** Talked to @YeldhamDev and confirmed this was intentional, and the rational makes sense. 

This PR seems to revert the behavior back to the broken version described in the issue, which can be summed up by the label/checkbox state not matching what is permitted in the viewport. 

Also, the comments are a bit too verbose. I think the code is self-explanatory.
